instagram.author: githubsignals
instagram.body:
The Ultimate Open Source Design Tool

Stop paying for restrictive design software and start building with total freedom. Open Design is a powerful, local-first alternative that lets you create professional web, mobile, and desktop prototypes entirely on your own terms. By integrating directly with popular AI coding models, it automates complex workflows to generate everything from slides to high-quality videos instantly. With native support for seventy-one different brand-grade design systems and versatile file exports, you maintain full control over your creative process without being locked into proprietary platforms. Take command of your workflow, keep your projects secure locally, and start designing your future today.

Open source: nexu-io/open-design
Spotted on Hacker News.
